note: Seed rule set, hand-written from NCC 2022 Housing Provisions Part 10.2 as the TARGET SCHEMA the Muse Wonder extractor must produce. Verify every value against the published NCC before relying on it.

sources.title: NCC 2022 Housing Provisions, Part 10.2 Wet area waterproofing

rules.text: The shower area floor must be at least 25 mm below the finished floor level outside the shower.
Where a shower screen is installed on a level-threshold shower, the waterstop vertical leg must finish at least 5 mm above finished floor level.
Wall/floor flashing vertical leg must be at least 25 mm above finished floor level, except across doorways.
Wall/floor flashing horizontal leg must be at least 50 mm wide.
Vertical flashings must extend at least 1800 mm above finished floor level.
For hobless showers and showers with hobs or stepdowns, the membrane must run up the wall to at least 1800 mm above the finished tile level of the floor.
For showers with hobs, the membrane must pass over the top of the hob, down the outside face, and terminate at least 50 mm onto the floor.
Internal flashings must have each leg overlapping at least 40 mm.
External flashing legs must allow at least 32 mm overlap with wall sheeting or render.
Wall area behind a washing machine must be water resistant from finished floor level to at least 75 mm above the tap outlets, and at least 75 mm either side of them.
Wall junctions and joints within 150 mm above an inset vessel must be water resistant, across the full width of the vessel.
Where a handheld bidet spray is installed, the area within a 900 mm radius of the wall connection must be waterproof up to at least 150 mm above the floor substrate.
